errors.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again, or go back to the home page.
errors.databaseDescription: We couldn't connect to the database, so this page can't be loaded right now.

connection: Make sure PostgreSQL is running (e.g. docker compose up -d or start the postgres container)
Check that the database port matches APIGENT_DATABASE_URL (default 5433)
Once the database is back, click “Try again”
migrations: The database is reachable but tables are missing — run the drizzle migrations first
